gui.mpsremodularized.creative.install.al: Installs compatible modules, highest tiers first, subject to available slots while in creative mode
gui.mpsremodularized.creative.install.de: Installs module into selected modular item while player is in creative mode
gui.mpsremodularized.install.desc: Installs the module in the selected item
gui.mpsremodularized.line1:
No Modular Powersuit items 
 found in inventory. Make some!
Emit a hologram of your surroundings to make yourself almost imperceptible.
item.mpsremodularized.aqua_affinity.desc: Reduces the speed penalty for using your tool underwater.
item.mpsremodularized.auto_feeder.desc: Whenever you're hungry, this module will grab the bottom-left-most food item from your inventory and feed it to you, storing the rest for later.
item.mpsremodularized.battery.desc: Experimental high end power storage device, now with almost no chance of exploding (we think). Despite nasty rumors, it is not based on stolen alien technology.
item.mpsremodularized.binoculars.desc: With the problems that have been plaguing Optifine lately, you've decided to take that Zoom ability into your own hands.
item.mpsremodularized.blade_launcher.des: Launches a spinning blade of death (or shearing).
item.mpsremodularized.blink_drive.desc: Select this Power Fist mode and right-click a block to teleport instantly. Increase Range in the Tinker Table to reach farther.
item.mpsremodularized.block_reach.desc: Extends block reach from vanilla +1 up to 59 blocks. Successful block actions cost 1,000 FE for each started block beyond vanilla reach; shorter actions cost less.
item.mpsremodularized.component_artifici: An electrical, artificial muscle, with less range of movement than human muscle but orders of magnitude more strength.
item.mpsremodularized.component_capacito: A drastically improved, overly powerful capacitor.
item.mpsremodularized.component_carbon_m: A small bundle of carbon fibers, refined for use in artificial muscles.
item.mpsremodularized.component_computer: An upgraded control circuit that contains a CPU which is capable of more advanced calculations.
item.mpsremodularized.component_force_fi: An advanced device which directly manipulates electromagnetic and gravitational fields in an area.
item.mpsremodularized.component_glider_w: A lightweight aerodynamic wing with an artificial muscle and electromagnet for deployment and retraction.
item.mpsremodularized.component_high_con: Consumed by the Metal Press with an MPS Component Mold installed. Contains the full crafting materials.
item.mpsremodularized.component_hologram: A multicolored laser array which can cheaply alter the appearance of something.
item.mpsremodularized.component_ion_thru: Essentially a miniature particle accelerator. Accelerates ions to near-light speed to produce thrust.
item.mpsremodularized.component_magnet.d: A metallic device that generates a magnetic field which pulls items towards the player.
item.mpsremodularized.component_mold.des: A reusable Immersive Engineering Metal Press mold for MPS plating, carbon myofiber and component templates.
item.mpsremodularized.component_myofiber: A thick, conductive paste, perfect for fitting between myofibers in an artificial muscle.
item.mpsremodularized.component_plating_: Structural crafting component made of diamond and used to create some modules.
Structural crafting component made of iron and used to create some modules.
Structural crafting component made of netherite and used to create some modules.
item.mpsremodularized.component_primitiv: Are you sure this thing will actually work? Is it supposed to smoke like that?
item.mpsremodularized.component_prototyp: Oh, look. It kind of works now.
A simple networkable microcontroller for coordinating an individual component.
item.mpsremodularized.component_rubber_h: A heavily insulated rubber hose capable of withstanding extreme heat or cold
item.mpsremodularized.component_servo.de: A special type of motor which uses a pulse-modulated signal to enact very precise movements.
item.mpsremodularized.component_solar_pa: A light sensitive device that will generate electricity from the sun.
item.mpsremodularized.component_solenoid: Wires wound around a ferromagnetic core produces a basic electromagnet.
Consumed by the Metal Press with an MPS Component Mold installed. Contains the full crafting materials.
item.mpsremodularized.component_wiring_h: Low-resistance wiring for advanced components. Made with electrum when available, otherwise gold.
item.mpsremodularized.component_wiring_s: A special type of wiring with high voltaic capacity and precision, necessary for the sensitive electronics in power armor.
item.mpsremodularized.component_wiring_t: Consumed by the Metal Press with an MPS Component Mold installed. Contains the full crafting materials.
item.mpsremodularized.coolant_tank.desc: Boosts output of thermal generators and provides emergency cooling
item.mpsremodularized.diamond_hoe.desc: An automated tilling addon to make it easy to till large swaths of land at once.
item.mpsremodularized.diamond_shovel.des: Shovels are good for soft materials like dirt and sand.
item.mpsremodularized.dim_tear_gen.desc: Select this Power Fist mode and right-click to travel between the Overworld and Nether at the same X/Z coordinates. Requires a safe landing nearby.
item.mpsremodularized.energy_shield.desc: Energy shields are much lighter than plating, but consume energy.
item.mpsremodularized.flight_control.des: An integrated control circuit to help you fly better. Press Z to go down.
item.mpsremodularized.flint_and_steel.de: A portable igniter that creates fire through the power of energy.
item.mpsremodularized.fortune.desc: A module that provides the fortune enchantment.
item.mpsremodularized.glider.desc: Tack on some wings to turn downward into forward momentum. Press sneak+forward while falling to activate.
item.mpsremodularized.iron_hoe.desc: An automated tilling addon to make it easy to till large swaths of land at once.
item.mpsremodularized.iron_shovel.desc: Shovels are good for soft materials like dirt and sand.
item.mpsremodularized.jet_boots.desc: Jet boots are not as strong as a jetpack, but they should at least be strong enough to counteract gravity.
item.mpsremodularized.jetpack.desc: A jetpack should allow you to jump indefinitely, or at least until you run out of power.
item.mpsremodularized.jump_assist.desc: An artificial muscle actuator helps you jump higher.
item.mpsremodularized.leaf_blower.desc: Create a torrent of air to knock plants out of the ground and leaves off of trees.
item.mpsremodularized.lightning_summoner: Allows you to summon lightning for a large energy cost.
item.mpsremodularized.lux_capacitor_modu: Launch a virtually infinite number of attractive light sources at the wall.
item.mpsremodularized.magnet.desc: Generates a magnetic field strong enough to attract items towards the player.         WARNING:                   This module drains power continuously. Turn it off when not needed.
item.mpsremodularized.melee_assist.desc: A much simpler addon, makes your powertool punches hit harder.
item.mpsremodularized.mob_repulsor.desc: Pushes mobs away from you when activated, but constantly drains power. It is highly recommended that you set this module to a keybind because of the high energy draw.
item.mpsremodularized.netherite_hoe.desc: An automated tilling addon to make it easy to till large swaths of land at once.
item.mpsremodularized.netherite_shovel.d: Shovels are good for soft materials like dirt and sand.
item.mpsremodularized.night_vision.desc: A pair of augmented vision goggles to help you see at night and underwater.
item.mpsremodularized.piglin_pacificatio: Simple module to make Piglins neutral as if wearing gold armor
item.mpsremodularized.plasma_cannon.desc: Use electrical arcs in a containment field to superheat air to a plasma and launch it at enemies.
item.mpsremodularized.plating_diamond.de: Diamond Plating is harder and more expensive to make, but offers better protection.
item.mpsremodularized.plating_iron.desc: Iron plating is heavy but offers a bit more protection.
Integrate a battery to allow the item to store energy.

item.mpsremodularized.railgun.desc: An assembly which accelerates a projectile to supersonic speeds using magnetic force. Heavy recoil.
item.mpsremodularized.selective_miner.de: Breaks blocks similar to the vein miner, but selectively. Shift and click to select block type.
item.mpsremodularized.shears.desc: Cuts through leaves, wool, and creepers alike.
item.mpsremodularized.shock_absorber.des: Artificial muscle, springs, and padding reduce a portion of fall damage.
item.mpsremodularized.silk_touch.desc: A module that provides the Silk Touch enchantment

item.mpsremodularized.solar_generator.de: Let the sun power your adventures.
item.mpsremodularized.sprint_assist.desc: Artificial muscles and servo motors help you sprint (double-tap forward) and walk faster.
item.mpsremodularized.stone_axe.desc: Primitive, but gets the job done
item.mpsremodularized.stone_hoe.desc: An automated tilling addon to make it easy to till large swaths of land at once.
item.mpsremodularized.stone_pickaxe.desc: The most basic mining module you can make.
item.mpsremodularized.stone_shovel.desc: Shovels are good for soft materials like dirt and sand.
item.mpsremodularized.swim_boost.desc: By refitting an ion thruster for underwater use, you may be able to add extra forward (or backward) thrust when underwater.

item.mpsremodularized.tier_2_smithing_up: Used for upgrading some modules and modular items from tier 1 to tier 2

item.mpsremodularized.tunnel_bore.desc: A module that enables the pickaxe module to mine 5x5 range blocks simultaneously.
item.mpsremodularized.unfinished_hologra: Finish in PneumaticCraft's Assembly Laser. Cannot be installed until processing is complete.
item.mpsremodularized.unfinished_plasma_: Finish in PneumaticCraft's Assembly Laser. Cannot be installed until processing is complete.
item.mpsremodularized.unfinished_railgun: Finish in PneumaticCraft's Assembly Laser. Cannot be installed until processing is complete.
item.mpsremodularized.universal_wrench.d: Select this Power Fist mode to rotate supported blocks and use installed mods' native wrench behavior. Sneak for the native wrench's alternate action. Requires Prototype tier or higher.
item.mpsremodularized.uphill_step_assist: Artificial muscle and control electronics help you step up 1m-high ledges.
item.mpsremodularized.vein_miner.desc: A module for mining ore veins
item.mpsremodularized.water_electrolyzer: When you run out of air, this module will jolt the water around you, electrolyzing a small bubble to breathe from.
item.mpsremodularized.wrench_module_fram: An unpowered wrench assembly used to craft the Universal Wrench Module. Crafting component only; cannot be used as a wrench.
message.mpsremodularized.blink.range: Blink Drive: increase Range in the Tinker Table.
message.mpsremodularized.blink.target: Blink Drive: aim at a block within range. Increase Range in the Tinker Table to reach farther.
message.mpsremodularized.blink.unsafe: Blink Drive: there is no safe space beside that block face.

message.mpsremodularized.rift.mounted: Dimensional Tear: dismount and remove passengers before travelling.
message.mpsremodularized.rift.unsafe: Dimensional Tear: no safe landing found nearby in the destination dimension.
tooltip.mpsremodularized.changeModes: Change modes: Press and hold the number of the hotbar slot the Power Fist is in.
